textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event: component("multiline"):SetInt(0) component("font"):Set(game.getTitleFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(2.0*game.menuScaleX()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_LEFT_ALIGNED) component:setColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) component("autoScaleFactor"):SetFloat(0.01) component("autoScale"):SetInt(1) component("alpha"):SetFloat(0.5) component("layer"):SetString("Cursor") component("visible"):SetInt(0) if game.isQABuild() then component("text"):SetString("QA_BUILD") component("visible"):SetInt(1) elseif game.isAdmin() and game.isDebugBuild() then component("text"):SetString("ADMIN") component("visible"):SetInt(1) end

textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event: component("multiline"):SetInt(0) component("font"):Set(game.getTitleFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.25*game.menuScaleX()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_LEFT_ALIGNED) component:setColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) component("autoScaleFactor"):SetFloat(0.01) component("autoScale"):SetInt(1) component("alpha"):SetFloat(0.5) component("layer"):SetString("Cursor") component("visible"):SetInt(0) if game.isAdmin() and game.inAdminViewMode() then component("text"):SetString("Admin View: "..game.getAdminViewUser()) component("visible"):SetInt(1) end

template.name: TokenCounter
template.event:
onInit(element)
element.currencyOptions[game.CurrencyType_Coins].ViewState = element.VIEW_STATE.ALERT element.currencyOptions[game.CurrencyType_Food].ViewState = element.VIEW_STATE.ALERT element.currencyOptions[game.CurrencyType_Diamonds].ViewState = element.VIEW_STATE.ALERT element.currencyOptions[game.CurrencyType_Shards].ViewState = element.VIEW_STATE.ALERT element.currencyOptions[game.CurrencyType_Medals].ViewState = element.VIEW_STATE.ALERT element.currencyOptions[game.CurrencyType_Starpower].ViewState = element.VIEW_STATE.ALERT element.currencyOptions[game.CurrencyType_Relics].ViewState = element.VIEW_STATE.ALERT element.currencyOptions[game.CurrencyType_MinigameTokens].ViewState = element.VIEW_STATE.ALERT element.currencyOptions[game.CurrencyType_EggWildcards].ViewState = element.VIEW_STATE.ALERT element.currencyOptions[game.CurrencyType_Keys].ViewState = element.VIEW_STATE.ALERT
element.currencyOptions[game.CurrencyType_ClubboxTokens].ViewState = element.VIEW_STATE.ALWAYS element.currencyOptions[game.CurrencyType_ClubboxTokens].ListenToFlyingIconComplete = true element.currencyOptions[game.CurrencyType_ClubboxTokens].ListenToPlayerUpdated = false

element.name: ViewButton

spriteSheetComponent.name: Sprite
spriteSheetComponent.event: component("sheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/buttons01.xml") if game.isInViewMode() then component("spriteName"):SetString("button_show_hud") component("alpha"):SetFloat(0.1) else component("spriteName"):SetString("button_hide_hud") component("alpha"):SetFloat(0.8) end component("size"):SetFloat(0.5) component("layer"):SetString("HUD")

touchComponent.name: Touch
touchComponent.event:
game.toggleViewMode()
element["Sprite"]("sheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/buttons01.xml") if game.isInViewMode() then element["Sprite"]("spriteName"):SetString("button_show_hud") --element["Sprite"]("alpha"):SetFloat(0.1) element:parent().ViewFader:Hide() else element["Sprite"]("spriteName"):SetString("button_hide_hud") --element["Sprite"]("alpha"):SetFloat(0.8) element:parent().ViewFader:Show() end element["Sprite"]("size"):SetFloat(0.5) element["Sprite"]("layer"):SetString("HUD")

element.event: if element("auto"):GetInt() == 1 then if manager:getContext() == manager:getDefaultContext() then element:DoStoredScript("show") else element:DoStoredScript("hide") end end
